ov: The largest group of marsupials in the Americas, 126 species. Only the Virginia opossum lives in the US and Canada, where it’s often called a possum. It’s usually non-aggressive and rarely carries rabies.
rg: The Americas, from Canada to South America.
fx: Gestation lasts only 11–13 days, and a litter can be over 20 young.
notes: Group entry (alias “possum”).
